responsibility: Implements x86 target option processing, override logic, and attribute handling for the i386 backend. This file owns processor and ISA selection tables, option validation and defaulting, function-specific target option save/restore and printing, offload-option serialization, veclib selection, OMP device trait matching, and the x86 attribute handlers and attribute table for calling conventions, ABI, interrupt, CET-related, and PE-specific attributes.
same_name_distinction: Implementation companion to i386-options.h: this .cc defines the x86 option-processing behavior and data such as attribute handlers and ix86_attribute_table, whereas the other same-stem files are declarations only.
